title: Codex CLI
limits: Codex prints "Model metadata ... not found" on every start: harmless, it does not know the model.
It will not send without STRATA_API_KEY set; any text works when the server has no key.
Where the sandbox cannot start (no bubblewrap), use --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox only in a throwaway folder.
Its system prompt and tools take about 8.6K tokens of the window.

files.text:
model = "qwen3.8-flash-next-unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl"
model_provider = "strata"
model_context_window = 4096
model_auto_compact_token_limit = 15000
model_reasoning_summary = "auto"
approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
check_for_update_on_startup = false

[model_providers.strata]
name = "Strata (local)"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
env_key = "STRATA_API_KEY"
stream_idle_timeout_ms = 600000
